mapper.select: SELECT performance_character_id, performance_project_id, name, description, importance_code, display_order FROM performance_character WHERE performance_character_id = #{performanceCharacterId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT performance_cast_id, performance_project_id, performance_character_id, public_profile_id, cast_type_code, display_order FROM performance_cast WHERE performance_cast_id = #{performanceCastId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT production_credit_id, performance_project_id, credit_role, public_name, public_profile_id, display_order FROM production_credit WHERE production_credit_id = #{productionCreditId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT performance_media_id, performance_project_id, stored_file_id, media_type_code, title, description, alt_text, credit_text, external_url, display_order, is_published FROM performance_media WHERE performance_media_id = #{performanceMediaId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT performance_character_id, performance_project_id, name, description, importance_code, display_order FROM performance_character WHERE performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} ORDER BY FIELD(importance_code, 'LEAD', 'SUPPORT', 'ENSEMBLE'), display_order, performance_character_id

SELECT pcast.performance_cast_id, pcast.performance_project_id, pcast.performance_character_id, pc.name AS character_name, pc.description AS character_description, pc.importance_code AS character_importance_code, pcast.public_profile_id, pcast.cast_type_code, pcast.display_order FROM performance_cast pcast JOIN performance_character pc ON pc.performance_character_id = pcast.performance_character_id AND pc.performance_project_id = pcast.performance_project_id WHERE pcast.performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} ORDER BY FIELD(pc.importance_code, 'LEAD', 'SUPPORT', 'ENSEMBLE'), pc.display_order, pcast.display_order, pcast.performance_cast_id

SELECT performance_cast_history_id, performance_project_id, performance_round_id, performance_character_id, previous_public_profile_id, new_public_profile_id, previous_cast_type_code, new_cast_type_code, scope_code, action_code, reason, changed_by_member_id, changed_dttm FROM performance_cast_history WHERE performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} ORDER BY changed_dttm DESC, performance_cast_history_id DESC

SELECT production_credit_id, performance_project_id, credit_role, public_name, public_profile_id, display_order FROM production_credit WHERE performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} ORDER BY display_order, production_credit_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_cast_history ( performance_project_id, performance_round_id, performance_character_id, previous_public_profile_id, new_public_profile_id, previous_cast_type_code, new_cast_type_code, scope_code, action_code, reason, changed_by_member_id, changed_dttm ) VALUES ( #{performanceProjectId}, #{performanceRoundId}, #{performanceCharacterId}, #{previousPublicProfileId}, #{newPublicProfileId}, #{previousCastType}, #{newCastType}, #{scope}, #{action}, #{reason}, #{changedByMemberId}, #{changedDttm} )
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_media SET media_type_code = #{mediaType}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, alt_text = #{altText}, credit_text = #{creditText}, external_url = #{externalUrl}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, is_published = #{published} WHERE performance_media_id = #{performanceMediaId}
